messages:
Juno (docs): Hi team — my docs PR #4708 is blocked by the preview. Linkcheck flagged /api/streaming#deadline (404) and the JS snippet still shows `request_timeout` which I thought was removed. Can runtime confirm server defaults and whether we should demonstrate AbortController + SDK helper?

preview-bot: Deploy preview 4708 — build failed. Linkcheck: broken anchor /api/streaming#deadline. Example test failed: streaming-deadline.test.js. Logs: https://deploy.example/4708/logs

Keiko (runtime): Quick answer: hosted server enforces a 120s stream inactivity deadline. We removed the client `request_timeout` param in SDK v1.3. Clients should use AbortController or the SDK's `withTimeout` helper. Dedicated: new pools default to 120s; some legacy Dedicated pools remain at 60s until migrated.

Juno (docs): Thanks. The PR currently has `client.stream({ model, request_timeout: 30_000 })` and a sentence that says "server default: 60s" — both wrong.

Arman (sdk): Confirmed: `request_timeout` accepted up to v1.2.x. v1.3 removed it. We added `client.withTimeout(ms, fn)` in v1.4 and recommend AbortController for streaming. Please pin examples to @redwood/sdk@1.5.4.

Leo (platform): Add a one-line backcompat note: "Hosted default 120s; legacy Dedicated pools may be 60s — contact support/SE if unsure." Keeps customers from being surprised.

Juno (docs): Plan: 1) replace `request_timeout` snippet with AbortController + optional `withTimeout` helper example (JS + one-line Python cancellation), 2) pin to @redwood/sdk@1.5.4, 3) fix the anchor to the correct heading id, 4) add the one-line backcompat note. ETA ~20m.

Arman (sdk): I'll quick-review after you push. Also suggest logging `res.routingDecision` in the example so users can debug why a stream ended.

Keiko (runtime): I'll provide the exact sentence you can copy: "Hosted streams: 120s inactivity deadline. Dedicated pools: 120s for new pools; legacy Dedicated pools may be 60s. If unsure, check your deployment profile or contact support."

preview-bot: Build queued for deploy-preview 4709.

Juno (docs): Pushed changes — replace snippet, fixed anchor, pinned SDK. Preview queued.

preview-bot: Deploy preview 4709 — success. Linkcheck fixed. Example test passed.

Arman (sdk): Snippet + helper usage look correct. LGTM.

Leo (platform): LGTM on wording and backcompat callout.

Juno (docs): Great — merging now. Thanks all :tada:
